title: STAR-FL: Secure Federated Learning with Spatial-Temporal Analysis and Robust Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14861v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data poisoning attacks pose serious security threats to Federated Learning (FL) systems in Computer Vision. Despite growing research attention, two key challenges remain for existing defense techniques: (1) accurately distinguishing between benign and malicious model updates and (2) effectively mitigating the influence of poisoned model updates during model aggregation. To address these challenges, we propose a novel defense framework against targeted poisoning attacks with Spatial-Temporal Analysis and Robust aggregation for FL (STAR-FL). First, we employ spatial-temporal clustering to identify and remove potentially malicious updates from the FL training process. Second, we adjust the learning rate during aggregation to mitigate the impact of any malicious updates that evade detection. Third, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets to evaluate the spatial-temporal analysis and robust aggregation in STAR-FL

translated_title: STAR-FL：具有时空分析与稳健聚合的安全联邦学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14861v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：数据投毒攻击对计算机视觉中的联邦学习（FL）系统构成严重安全威胁。尽管研究关注度不断增长，现有防御技术仍面临两个关键挑战：（1）准确区分良性模型更新与恶意模型更新；（2）在模型聚合过程中有效缓解被投毒模型更新的影响。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种针对定向投毒攻击的新型防御框架，结合时空分析与稳健聚合用于FL（STAR-FL）。首先，我们采用时空聚类来识别并从FL训练过程中移除潜在恶意更新。其次，我们在聚合过程中调整学习率，以减轻任何逃避检测的恶意更新的影响。第三，我们在多个基准数据集上进行广泛实验，以评估STAR-FL中的时空分析和稳健聚合。
tldr: 该论文提出STAR-FL框架，通过时空聚类识别恶意更新和调整学习率缓解投毒影响，有效提升联邦学习对数据投毒攻击的防御能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes STAR-FL, a framework that uses spatial-temporal clustering to identify malicious updates and adjusts learning rates to mitigate poisoning effects, enhancing federated learning defense against data poisoning attacks.
